name: print-social-business-woman-rocket-concept-photo
title: Business woman riding a red toy rocket concept photo
whatItIs: A composited studio photo of a businesswoman in a red suit riding a small red rocket, isolated on white with a soft shadow, used as a growth/launch metaphor.
whatItMeans: A literal visual pun (person + rocket = 'launch') gives an abstract business idea an instantly readable, slightly humorous image that works across many contexts.
techniques: build a literal visual metaphor by compositing a person with a symbolic prop
isolate the composite on pure white so it drops into any layout with negative space to spare
color-match the subject's outfit to the prop for a designed, unified look

vocabulary.definition: an image that represents an abstract idea through a literal or symbolic visual comparison
